text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I... I went and lost again. What a 
pathetic mess... How uncool...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate... I'll never reach the 
coolness I've been striving for...!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...!? Why...! Why the hell would you 
say that?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Even though we've been losing over and 
over again... Do you have any real basis 
for that!?"
choice_data_list:
Because I know how hard you've worked, 
Vodka!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...That did the trick, Trainer. Thanks to 
you... that stupid cowardice got blown 
right out of me."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You've always got your eyes on me, and 
after getting pushed forward this much by 
you—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Sitting around moping forever is way more 
pathetic than actually losing!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Someday... Someday, absolutely! I'm gonna 
seize victory looking cool as hell!!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
N-No way in hell...! Like I'd ever accept 
that...!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I haven't even begun to... to everyone 
cheering me on, or to you—"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Because more than anyone else, I haven't 
been able to live up to my own standard of 
coolness!!
choice_data_list:
Then let's keep giving it our all as many 
times as it takes!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Right... You're damn right! Whining like 
that ain't like me at all!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"If my current strength ain't enough, then 
I'll just keep biting at their heels till 
it is!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Just you wait, Trainer! I'm definitely 
gonna— show you how insanely cool I can 
be!!"
